text: Experts believe that artificial intelligence will change our world in big ways. Today, AI is good at specific tasks, but the future may bring AGI, or artificial general intelligence. AGI would think and learn like a human, solving many different problems. This could bring great benefits, such as better healthcare, faster scientific discoveries, and help with difficult global issues. However, there are also risks. AGI might take jobs, be used for harm, or become hard to control. Scientists disagree about when AGI will arrive. Some say in 20 years, while others think it may take much longer, or may never happen at all.
